scenes.text: So can Claude replace Jira? I gave it one written spec for a bug tracker, and the spec is free. Customers can even report bugs through a public form.
But when a customer's report turned out to be a duplicate, my spec was silent. Do they get an email? Claude had to guess.
Now they don't. They hear once, when the real bug is verified, and the person who fixed it can't verify it.
All thirty-one checks passed, and all five gaps are fixed. But real email sending was never tested, so check that first.
